title: Capture redesign brief and baseline screenshots
deliverable: Document the current admin routes, baseline screenshots, pain points, and redesign success criteria using the Tryambakam board and HTML references as source inputs.
acceptance: A route-by-route baseline inventory exists for login and all protected pages.
Before screenshots are captured for desktop and mobile.
The redesign brief identifies what to preserve, what to remove, and what to elevate.
validation: Attach baseline screenshots.
Review the brief against the current route inventory.

title: Define Tryambakam color token system
deliverable: Convert the Void Teal, Phosphor Cream, Solar Bronze, Titanium Mist, and Chlorophyll palette into admin-web design tokens with usage rules.
acceptance: Semantic tokens exist for background, panel, line, text, accent, danger, success, and muted states.
The palette explicitly bans generic purple/blue neon usage.
Token usage rules distinguish editorial accents from operational surfaces.
validation: Token preview screenshots or swatches are attached.
Contrast checks are documented for primary text and critical controls.

title: Define typography hierarchy and numeric language
deliverable: Establish Exo 2 and Space Grotesk roles for headings, data, labels, tables, and telemetry surfaces.
acceptance: A type scale exists for display, section titles, body, helper text, and mono telemetry.
Numbers and key IDs have a distinct, reusable treatment.
The hierarchy works in both dense tables and editorial hero surfaces.
validation: Typography specimens are attached.
The hierarchy is reviewed across at least dashboard, users, and API keys contexts.

title: Define ornament, iconography, and illustration rules
deliverable: Create rules for bronze filigree, circuit-line motifs, icon set usage, and where ornamental elements are allowed or banned.
acceptance: A single icon system is selected and normalized.
Decorative filigree is constrained to framing moments and never blocks data legibility.
Illustration rules support the regenerative architecture theme without becoming ornamental clutter.
validation: Reference examples are attached.
The rule set is reviewed against dashboard and modal contexts.

title: Rebuild protected shell v2
deliverable: Redesign the sidebar, topbar, route framing, and status rail into a cohesive control shell aligned to the new design system.
acceptance: Navigation, active state, route context, and account status all reflect the new shell.
The shell scales cleanly across desktop and mobile breakpoints.
No auth or permission behavior regresses.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Auth and protected-route smoke checks pass.

title: Build layout, panel, and card primitives
deliverable: Create reusable section, panel, card, and grid primitives that replace the current generic shell styling.
acceptance: Shared primitives exist for page shells, panel groupings, and dense metric surfaces.
Borders, spacing, and elevation follow a single system.
Primitives support both airy and dense admin layouts.
validation: Component examples are attached.
At least two existing pages are migrated as proof of reuse.

title: Build modal, drawer, and action rail primitives
deliverable: Create the canonical management detail surfaces used for drill-down, confirmation, and contextual actions.
acceptance: A shared wide modal or drawer pattern exists for management details.
An action rail pattern exists for rotate, revoke, delete, edit, and bulk actions.
Focus trapping and close behavior are consistent.
validation: Keyboard and click-away behavior are tested.
The API key modal remains functional after migration.

title: Build global loading, empty, error, and success states
deliverable: Create a unified state system for page and component feedback across the admin surface.
acceptance: State patterns exist for loading, empty, error, and success conditions.
States are visually aligned to the new shell and token system.
Errors use accessible announcement patterns.
validation: Examples are attached across table, card, and modal contexts.
Assistive announcement behavior is verified.

title: Create data table v2 interaction model
deliverable: Define the shared admin table pattern for row-open detail flows, column density, sorting affordances, and action placement.
acceptance: Tables support row-click drill-down by default.
Column hierarchy is consistent across pages.
Actions no longer clutter the primary data plane.
validation: Apply the pattern to at least users and API keys.
Responsive overflow behavior is verified.

title: Create metric tile and trend primitives
deliverable: Build reusable executive and operational metric components for dashboard, analytics, and system surfaces.
acceptance: Metric tiles support status, trend, and supporting annotation.
The components work in both editorial hero bands and dense grids.
Numeric hierarchy follows the typography system.
validation: Examples are attached in dashboard and analytics contexts.
Data placeholders and empty states are covered.

title: Create filter bar, search, and chip patterns
deliverable: Standardize query inputs, tier or status filters, chips, and view controls across list pages.
acceptance: All list surfaces share one filter bar pattern.
Search, status, and tier filters are visually and behaviorally consistent.
Chip and preset patterns are reusable.
validation: The pattern is applied to at least two pages.
Keyboard focus and small-screen behavior are tested.

title: Create timeline and event stream primitives
deliverable: Build a reusable event stream and timeline pattern for audit logs, history sync, and system narratives.
acceptance: Timeline entries have a consistent header, badge, and metadata structure.
The primitive handles dense event streams without visual collapse.
The pattern supports drill-down details.
validation: Examples are attached for audit and history sync.
Long lists are tested for readability.

title: Add responsive navigation and mobile behavior
deliverable: Define how the shell, page headers, tables, and drawers collapse on tablet and mobile.
acceptance: Navigation remains usable on narrow screens.
Tables degrade gracefully into scroll or stacked patterns where needed.
No horizontal layout breakage occurs on supported widths.
validation: Mobile screenshots are attached.
The layout is checked at 320px, 768px, and desktop.

title: Add motion system and reduced-motion rules
deliverable: Define subtle motion patterns for hover, reveal, panel transition, and row drill-down while respecting reduced-motion.
acceptance: Motion supports hierarchy and responsiveness rather than decoration.
Reduced-motion behavior is explicitly handled.
No animation introduces layout shift or performance regression.
validation: Before and after interaction captures are attached.
Reduced-motion behavior is demonstrated.

title: Add accessibility, focus, and keyboard contracts
deliverable: Codify focus rings, keyboard movement, dialog focus traps, and semantic announcements for the shared primitives.
acceptance: Keyboard navigation works through shell, tables, and modals.
Focus states are visible and consistent.
Alerts and errors are announced correctly.
validation: Keyboard-only walkthrough notes are attached.
Axe or equivalent spot checks are recorded.

title: Add command palette and global quick actions
deliverable: Introduce a global quick-action layer for navigation and high-frequency admin tasks.
acceptance: The command palette can navigate between key admin routes.
At least a few high-frequency actions are exposed.
The interaction fits the new shell and keyboard model.
validation: Keyboard invocation is demonstrated.
The palette is tested on desktop and tablet.

title: Redesign public login and auth entry
deliverable: Recast the login and auth-entry experience in the new brand language without breaking current auth flows.
acceptance: Login visuals match the new shell direction.
Credential and Discord paths remain functional.
Loading and failure states are elevated.
validation: Login screenshots are attached.
Manual auth flow checks are recorded.

title: Redesign dashboard overview
deliverable: Transform the dashboard into a high-signal observatory surface with clear hierarchy and operational summaries.
acceptance: The dashboard uses the new hero, metric, and panel system.
Primary decisions and alerts are visible above the fold.
The page feels strategic rather than generic.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Desktop and mobile layouts are shown.

title: Redesign users index
deliverable: Rebuild the users page around the new table, filter, and management hierarchy.
acceptance: The users index uses shared table and filter primitives.
User signals and actions are easier to scan.
The page supports future bulk action growth.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Table interactions are verified.

title: Build user detail drawer and action clusters
deliverable: Add drill-down user management surfaces so row selection opens richer user context and actions.
acceptance: Users rows open into a shared management detail surface.
State, tier, and role actions are grouped coherently.
The interaction aligns with the modal or drawer primitive.
validation: Keyboard and mouse flows are tested.
Action confirmations are demonstrated.

title: Re-theme API keys around the new design system
deliverable: Visually align the shipped API key management flow with the new shell, primitives, and brand language.
acceptance: The API keys page uses the final shell and token system.
The management modal feels integrated with the redesign rather than isolated.
Secret and danger-zone treatments remain legible and serious.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Create, rotate, revoke, and delete flows are smoke tested.

title: Redesign history sync page
deliverable: Recast history sync into a more intelligible reconciliation workspace using the new timeline and table patterns.
acceptance: The page clearly separates users, devices, and events.
Statuses and drift cues are easier to read.
The page fits the new information hierarchy.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
State variants are demonstrated.

title: Redesign analytics page
deliverable: Rebuild analytics into a more elegant command surface with better metric hierarchy, filters, and chart framing.
acceptance: The analytics page uses the metric and filter primitives consistently.
Charts and tables feel like one system.
The page emphasizes decisions, not just raw output.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Empty and loaded states are both shown.

title: Redesign system health page
deliverable: Upgrade system health into a technical observability surface with stronger status logic and hierarchy.
acceptance: The page uses the new panel and timeline system.
Service health, cache state, and workflow health are visually distinct.
The layout supports both dense and summary views.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Status-state styling is checked across healthy and degraded examples.

title: Redesign audit log page
deliverable: Rebuild the audit page into a more legible event narrative with better filtering, chronology, and detail reveal.
acceptance: Audit events use the shared event stream primitives.
Filtering and drill-down feel coherent with the rest of the redesign.
Dense event review remains readable.
validation: Before and after screenshots are attached.
Event detail flow is demonstrated.

title: Add page-level state variants across all screens
deliverable: Apply the shared loading, empty, error, and success system across every admin route.
acceptance: Every major page has intentional loading, empty, and failure states.
No route falls back to raw utility copy or unstyled placeholders.
The state system remains visually consistent.
validation: A screenshot set covers each route state.
Accessibility announcements are checked for error states.

title: Add bulk action patterns for users and keys
deliverable: Define and implement coherent bulk selection and bulk action workflows for the most important management pages.
acceptance: Users and API keys support a shared bulk selection model.
Bulk actions have clear safety and feedback behavior.
The pattern is compatible with future expansion.
validation: Bulk flows are demonstrated with screenshots or video.
Action feedback is verified.

title: Add breadcrumbs, deep links, and context persistence
deliverable: Preserve navigation context across pages, modal states, and return flows so the dashboard feels like a coherent workspace.
acceptance: Context is preserved when navigating between linked admin flows.
Deep-link entry points resolve into meaningful state.
Breadcrumb or route context is visible where helpful.
validation: Round-trip navigation is demonstrated.
Deep-link behavior is tested from shared URLs.

title: Add destructive action safety taxonomy
deliverable: Standardize how revoke, rotate, delete, and user-impacting actions communicate risk, reversibility, and confirmation requirements.
acceptance: Destructive actions share a clear visual taxonomy.
Permanent actions are unmistakably different from reversible ones.
Confirmation copy is consistent across pages.
validation: A taxonomy matrix is attached.
At least three destructive flows are reviewed.

title: Add admin interaction telemetry and performance instrumentation
deliverable: Instrument key admin interactions and page performance signals so the redesigned dashboard can be observed in production.
acceptance: Core interaction telemetry is emitted for major admin workflows.
Page performance signals can be reviewed after deploy.
The instrumentation does not pollute the UI layer with ad hoc logic.
validation: Telemetry events are documented and sampled.
Performance evidence is captured on the deployed app.

title: Add screenshot-based visual regression coverage
deliverable: Set up screenshot-based regression checks for the redesigned admin shell and core pages.
acceptance: A baseline screenshot set exists for key routes.
Regression diffs are reviewable in CI or a documented workflow.
Core pages are covered at least at one desktop viewport.
validation: The baseline capture workflow is documented.
A sample regression run is attached.

title: Add accessibility QA and keyboard journey tests
deliverable: Build the accessibility validation pass for shell, tables, modals, and route-specific workflows.
acceptance: Keyboard-only journeys exist for major flows.
Modal, table, and shell access patterns are checked.
Critical accessibility issues are tracked or resolved.
validation: A QA checklist is attached.
Test evidence is recorded for major flows.

title: Run cross-page design polish and consistency pass
deliverable: Perform the final visual and interaction consistency pass across the full dashboard after all route work lands.
acceptance: Spacing, color usage, motion, and typography are normalized.
No page feels visually orphaned from the system.
The final pass improves taste without changing contracts.
validation: A consistency checklist is attached.
Before and after comparisons are included for the most improved pages.

title: Prepare rollout, canary checklist, and final acceptance signoff
deliverable: Prepare the deployment, canary, and acceptance artifacts required to land the redesign safely.
acceptance: A rollout and canary checklist exists for the redesigned admin portal.
Acceptance criteria are reviewed against the original redesign brief.
Open risks and deferred items are documented.
validation: The canary checklist is attached.
Final acceptance notes reference production verification.
